verdict.rationale: PagerDuty's hosted developer.pagerduty.com/api-reference is described as an interactive OpenAPI reference covering its REST, Events, SCIM, MCP server and integration APIs. It includes endpoints, schemas and code samples, and lets users try requests directly from the docs through a try-it console; the OpenAPI spec is also published publicly for Postman import. The probe 404s on support.pagerduty.com OpenAPI paths are a different domain and do not contradict this. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the try-it console, and detail on how far the runnable examples go (languages, auth handling in the console).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
